UI_NE_Start_1: ...I must have passed out. ...My body feels feverish and strange.
UI_NE_Start_2: ...I recognize these clothes. ...Are they from Dr. Hiro, the researcher who treated me as a sample?
UI_NE_Start_3: (*Cough, gasp!!*) From the back of my throat... chunks of darkened blood are overflowing!
UI_NE_Start_3_ThroatPain: ...My throat burns... it hurts to swallow...
UI_NE_Start_4: I was supposed to be transported out of state from the airport. ...So why am I in a place like this?
UI_NE_Start_5: ...To investigate this abnormality in my body, I have no choice but to go to the military research facility where I was being experimented on. If I search this lab coat, maybe there is a clue?
UI_NE_Card_Reminder: ...I can't leave yet. I must check Dr. Hiro's lab coat.
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Dist: The doctor's body should still have the door key on it. I have to go back and search...
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Wake: I dreamed about that doctor again... I feel I have to go back and get the key.
UI_NE_Phase_2: Something is shivering deep within my body... (Phase: Omen)
UI_NE_Phase_3: The world is creaking. There's no turning back. (Phase: Decay)
UI_NE_Phase_4: The final bell tolls. It is judgment day. (Phase: Judgment)
